scenes.a: The heavy concern you carried here can rest.
Tonight, hear the promise of Nahum chapter one, verse seven:
scenes.sub: GOD STAYS NEAR IN THE DARK

scenes.a: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
scenes.sub: A STRONG HOLD IN DAY OF TROUBLE

scenes.a: Lord, when trouble presses into this quiet room tonight, remind us that You are our strong fortress.
You know each hidden worry we cannot solve before we sleep.
scenes.sub: YOU SEE WHAT WE CANNOT SOLVE

scenes.a: Hold us in Your enduring goodness and shield us with Your stillness.
We place every burden into Your safe hands and rest peacefully under Your care.
Amen. The heavy concern you carried here can rest.
